# Literal rank-five kernel promotion

Start with the exact raw PR552 word reconstructed from the pinned package. Immediately after the center, its B prefix contains 320 gauge compensation gates followed by 168 kernel shears. The latter use 14 disjoint groups with four donor helpers and four pivot helpers each. The four donor response columns span the four pivot response columns over dyadic rationals. Donors enter at the group's rank-one gauge line; pivots enter at a common rank-four frame E.

For groups 10 and 6, all eight helpers' first downstream frames contain a common rank-five frame F containing E. The exact chosen frames are:

| Group | E | F | Promoted pivots |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 10 | 260,132,96,24 | 260,132,96,24,1 | 419,421,422,423 |
| 6 | 267,139,96,30 | 267,139,96,25,7 | 451,453,454,455 |

These integer lists encode bases in the inherited nine-dimensional binary frame convention. `promote.py` checks both ranks and the actual span containment. It changes each pivot's entrance frame and its three outgoing kernel shear frames from E to F. Every scalar gate and coefficient is retained. Kernel gates commute because the set of donor destinations is disjoint from the set of pivot sources, so placing the retained rank-four kernel gates before the promoted rank-five gates leaves the scalar word unchanged. The cleanup is regenerated as the literal reversed inverse of the changed word.

The original scalar dirty-response cancellation therefore still holds. It is nevertheless checked independently for every one of the 728 formal columns, including every arbitrary dirty helper, in forward and inverse-transpose orientations. The additional omission controls remove each promoted pivot's three corrections and recompute only literal cleanup; the correct word's compensation table is frozen and each resulting wrong operator must be rejected.

Each selected group has downstream first-helper rank six. Its four donors previously climbed rank 1→4→6, paying four rank-three and four rank-two children. They now climb 1→5→6, paying four rank-four and four rank-one children. Its four pivots previously climbed 4→6 and now climb 5→6. Thus one complete four-pivot group has profile delta `{1:+8,2:-8,3:-4,4:+4}` and replaces four width-five helpers by four width-four helpers. Two groups produce the complete local profile and width inventory stated in the README. The actual full frame-chain calculation and both independently emitted reflected ledgers verify this count; it is not obtained by scaling an isolated pivot.

Physical hosting is a separate obligation. The new width-four helper roles require a newly constructed literal owner map and plan. The final verifier must derive the globally paid profile from those actual owners, check stage and chart legality, compile every exact phase edge, compute the finite invoice, certify both moment engines including fallback, and satisfy every outer-assembly inequality. A positive local or relaxed packing calculation alone is not admission.
